editorial:
Imagine spending your whole life working hard to build a fortune, only to tell your kids you are giving it all away to charity. That is exactly what happens to Untaro Tatsumura. He is a retired businessman living a chill life by the coast with his wife, but his peaceful days end the moment he drops that money bomb on his family. You get to see a lot of funny and tense family drama as his kids and relatives suddenly act like they love him just to get a piece of the pie. It feels like a classic family fight that could happen in any home, just with much higher stakes.

What really works here is how the movie shows the greed of the family members. The acting is great because you can see the fake smiles and the hidden anger on their faces. While it moves a bit slower than modern films, the dialogue keeps you interested. If you enjoy old-school dramas about money and family secrets, you will love this. You should definitely look for a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture, or try renting it on Apple TV if you want a quick watch.
endingExplained: In the end, the family's greed backfires completely. After trying every trick to stop the donation, they realize that Untaro is serious about his choice. The movie wraps up with the family having to face the reality that they cannot rely on their father's wealth. It ends as a lesson on greed, showing that the children missed their chance to truly bond with their father because they only cared about his bank account.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family dramas and stories about inheritance battles.
